traditionalCmsBaseline.name: Traditional CMS baseline
traditionalCmsBaseline.notes: Analytical baseline for a monolithic CMS where frontend rendering, plugins, templates and administration are hosted in the same application runtime.
expectedTraits: Tighter coupling between content model and rendered templates
Scaling usually applies to the whole CMS runtime rather than individual API concerns

measurementContext: Plesk hosting server requesting public HTTPS endpoints; five sequential samples per URL, without browser rendering or an explicit warm-up.
